source_logic_audit.as_caller: sprite496 onShow/presetAllSkills at authored-actions.txt 0x20b2d-0x20db3 loops positions 0..15, calls NativeGetSkillDetails(position,result,player0), writes SkillLevel into both rank-field copies, and applies SkillAssignable, SkillUnlocked, SkillIcon/rank visibility branches. The selection handler at 0x20ea calls NativeGetSkillDetails for the selected position and assigns SkillName, SkillDescription, GAMEPLAYMENUS_current_level + two newlines + SkillCurrLevel, and GAMEPLAYMENUS_next_level + two newlines + SkillNextLevel.
source_logic_audit.native_details: port/engine-ui/hud_initialization_v1.cpp::details reproduces NativeGetSkillDetails. The selected source row supplies current/next OIDs and display-property IDs. Below Character required level, current text is GAMEPLAYMENUS_SKILL_UNLOCK_AT_LEVEL with the exact required level and SkillUnlocked stays false; the AI display-value branch is skipped. At/above the required level, rank 0 uses GAMEPLAYMENUS_NEEDS_SKILL_POINTS; otherwise current text uses the current OID. Next text checks difficulty-specific CharacterDesign max-level constants, then CanIncrementSkill, using GAMEPLAYMENUS_MAX_SKILL_LEVEL or GAMEPLAYMENUS_SKILL_MAXIMUM_LEVEL_TRAINING as appropriate, otherwise the next OID. For each eligible current and next rank, the source runs AI_SkillInfo(index, rank), reads each source display property as fixed point, appends its integer/fraction to native VarArgs, and StringManager parseEx formats the string. Both current and next values are faery-offset-adjusted for faery-dependent skills using the same current-faery row.
